        allow_population_by_field_name = True
        anystr_strip_whitespace = True

        populate_by_name=True,

        extra='forbid',
    )", "explanation": "The `class Config` is deprecated in v2 (migration.md, Changes to config). It becomes `model_config = ConfigDict(...)`.         allow_mutation = False", "replace": "    model_config = ConfigDict(frozen=True)", "explanation": "The `class Config` is deprecated in v2 (migration.md, Changes to config). `allow_mutation` was removed. Its inverse, `frozen=True`, gives the same effect of blocking attribute assignment on the model."}], "notes": "Three edits cover all three findings. Behavior note for AuditEntry: in v1, `allow_mutation = False` made assignment raise TypeError. In v2, `frozen=True` makes assignment raise a ValidationError instead, so any caller that catches TypeError on assignment will need updating. Customer's `extra='forbid'` and the string-literal change keep the same behavior. Edits do not overlap, and the search strings are unique in the file. The import edit removes `Extra`, which is no longer referenced after the config edits."}
